messages:
maria.chen: FYI customers on Dedicated reported a sharp jump in audit billing after a recent UI webhook launch. billing up ~3x. can we triage which audit categories and whether schema/mapping changes caused more indexing or extra KMS ops?
aj: oof. do we have a sample window? is this RBAC/authz noise or UI telemetry?
devon: grabbed a 1h shipper capture from staging+prod. lots of `session.pulse` and `cursor.move` events. high-cardinality fields (email, device_id) were mapped as keywords -> ES exploded.
chao: confirmed. `actor.email` was merged as `keyword` in last PR. that made every unique email a term. immediate fix: revert mapping and change to `actor.email_hash` or index: false. also suggests we stop indexing device ids.
elleiot: also seeing KMS usage spike. current shipper wraps each event's CEK individually -> N KMS calls. we should batch-wrap per N events.
securitybot: alert: potential PII in `cursor.move` payloads detected. recommend source-side redaction or hashing, and flag for legal review if any raw email persisted in index. :lock:
maria.chen: proposal: two-tier fidelity for audit streams
  - fidelity:full -> admin/authz/token events: full indexing, retained 90d, searchable
  - fidelity:reduced -> high-volume UI events/heartbeats: minimal metadata indexed, canonical blob to object store, 7d hot index
aj: makes sense. but customers under compliance expect exact audit rows for e-discovery. how do we surface sampled/reduced events to them? must be provable.
devon: keep canonical encrypted blob in S3 with stable object id. index pointer + minimal metadata. on customer request we fetch blob, verify signature/HMAC, and return. avoids continuous indexing.
chao: optimize KMS: use per-batch CEK and wrap once. pseudocode below:

```
# shipper batch encrypt
for batch in batches:
  CEK = generate_cek()
  wrapped = KMS.wrap(CEK)   # 1 KMS call per batch
  for evt in batch:
    encrypted = encrypt(evt, CEK)
    store_s3(encrypted)
  index(minimal_metadata + s3_pointer + wrapped)
```

aj: solid. add HMAC per-batch derived from CEK so we can verify integrity cheaply on fetch. HMAC is far cheaper than KMS.
elliot: also: legal wants retention proof for some tenants. consider publishing a per-tenant daily Merkle root (or bloom + signed hash) to an append-only ledger so we can prove event existed at time T even if sampled.
securitybot: note: decryption on-demand leads to KMS unwraps. consider short-lived CEK unwrap caching in an HSM-backed cache but limit TTL and rate. risk: unwrapping for bulk exports needs strict controls.
chao: ingestion/backpressure: shipper currently flushes ~ every 2s or 50k events. under surges this results in huge ES bulk indexing spikes + KMS traffic. suggested rules:
  - per-tenant soft-queue with dynamic sampling when queue > 75%
  - circuit-breaker: 429 + Retry-After for non-critical events when under pressure
  - hot-lane for critical audit types (authz/admin) that bypass sampling
aj: must be reflected in API/Console so customers understand sampling ratios. expose sampling metadata in responses and UI and allow on-demand rehydration of full blobs.
maria.chen: schema CI change: add gating check for new mappings. heuristic: if a PR adds `keyword` on a field and our sample shows >X unique terms per 24h, fail and require maintainer ack. ticket AU-3487.
devon: created AU-3488 for shipper batch-encrypt POC (owner: chao). will run on staging next week.
chao: AU-3489 for sampling-policy + customer API changes (owner: aj). spec by Wed.
elliot: rough numbers from our sample:
  - KMS per-event vs per-batch: ~10-100x reduction depending on batch size
  - indexing footprint down ~3x if we stop indexing high-cardinality fields
  - S3 + occasional decrypts cheaper than persistent indexing for massive streams
securitybot: ops note: ensure access to rehydrated blobs is logged (audit-access) and KMS unwraps are recorded. legal might request export logs.
maria.chen: customer-visible flow idea:
  1) customer queries /audit/events?tenant=acme&since=ts -> returns indexed metadata + s3 pointers + `sampled: true/false`
  2) if they request full body, we fetch S3 blob, verify HMAC, optionally decrypt (per tenant policy), serve, and log access
  3) every access triggers an audit-access row and increments a KMS unwrap metric

securitybot: ops security constraints:
  - do not cache unwrapped CEKs > 60s
  - bulk exports require elevated approval and rate-limiting
  - HSM cache TTL and unwrap QPS must be throttled per-tenant

devon: action items recap:
  - AU-3487: schema-mapping-gate CI (devon) - EOD Fri
  - AU-3488: shipper-batch-encrypt POC (chao) - staging run next week
  - AU-3489: sampling policy + customer API + console updates (aj) - spec Wed

maria.chen: tagging @support_lead to prep customer communications once we have rollout plan. post any relevant logs/snippets here. :white_check_mark:
opsbot: created AU-3487, AU-3488, AU-3489 and scheduled mitigation sync on 2024-04-15 16:00 UTC.
